instruction.name: VP2INTERSECTD/VP2INTERSECTQ
instruction.copyright: Copyright (C) Intel Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
instruction.shortdesc: Compute Intersection Between DWORDS/QUADWORDS to a Pair of Mask Registers

note.string: This instruction writes an even/odd pair of mask registers. The mask register destination indicated in the MODRM.REG field is used to form the basis of the register pair. The low bit of that field is masked off (set to zero) to create the first register of the pair.
EVEX.aaa and EVEX.z must be zero.
